description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents. By fostering collaborative intelligence, CrewAI empowers agents to work together seamlessly, tackling complex tasks.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### Features
- Make gpt-6-luna crewAI's default model everywhere
- Read spreadsheet URLs in an agent's input with tools over every row
- Tag eval usage spans with target and a per-evaluation id
- Add --no-open to crewai eval for headless use

### Bug Fixes
- Count a crewai eval run that exits with an error as run_failed
- Create the project .env owner-only when crewai eval turns tracing on
- Upload a failed anonymous run that crewai eval started
- Check openai-compatible providers' API key on the first call
- Scope memoized crew methods to their instance
- Exit non-zero when crewai run's project script fails
- Eval asks to share the trace with Enter meaning yes, and explains why

### Documentation
- Document required_inputs on GET /inputs and which flow fields are inputs

## Contributors

@joaomdmoura

hot_issues.title: Tool re-execution on task retry has no idempotency guard — duplicate payments, emails, trades possible
[FEATURE]:Governance middleware hook for tool call authorization
[FEATURE] Runtime release-control mediation layer before agent/tool execution
[FEATURE] Native deterministic guardrail to prevent infinite agent delegation and tool loops
[FEATURE] Add pre-execution validation for agent-to-agent actions
[FEATURE] Memory write guards for multi-agent crews — prevent cross-agent memory poisoning
Agent governance: deterministic tool permission gating for crew agents
[BUG] `human_input=True`: the feedback prompt references a "Final Result above" that is never displayed unless `verbose=True`
